Rows and columns of a data frame, chosen as illumex chooses them

Source: R/ilm_subset.R, R/zzz-iml-aliases.R
ilm_subset.Rd

The data an illumex function would use after subset and cols: the rows first, then the columns. Row names keep the original row numbers (or the original names, if the data had them), and the attribute "ilm_select" says what was chosen.

Usage

ilm_subset(
  data,
  subset = NULL,
  subset_negate = FALSE,
  subset_fixed = FALSE,
  cols = NULL,
  cols_negate = FALSE,
  cols_fixed = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

subset, subset_negate, subset_fixed

Which rows; see ilm_selection.

cols, cols_negate, cols_fixed

Which columns; see ilm_selection.

Value

A data frame.

See also

ilm_selection, ilm_sample().

Examples

d <- ilm_sim()
ilm_subset(d, subset = c(grp = "^a"), cols = "^score|^income")
